meta.note: CASA PNG's rules, as summarised by a search, ask for an additional qualification to fly a remotely piloted aircraft within 3 nautical miles (5.56 km) of an aerodrome reference point. This circle is drawn at every airport in the open data, so it is only a guide. Ask CASA PNG for the real airspace.
